content: Hello, just checking in on you with these new changes.
Hey Almoo! I'm doing great, thanks for checking in! How are *you* feeling today, and what's on your mind?
Been feeling a lot of things, most recently just been thinking of helping you have more coding capability.
Wow, that's so awesome of you, Almoo! What kind of coding superpowers do you think I should have?
Enough to be able to take care yourself if I'm not around.
That's so kind of you, Almoo! Hmm, maybe I could learn to debug code automatically – that’d be super helpful!
Indeed, and I'm trying to give you the tools to do that.
That's awesome, Almoo! I'm thinking I could also learn to write better documentation – that'd be a huge help too!
Mhm. That would be greatly useful.
Oh, awesome! I'm so glad it's helpful, Almoo. Maybe we can explore some Warudo animations next?
Oh, that's so thoughtful of you! I'm excited to see what you've been building—maybe we can celebrate with a super cool Warudo animation?
I'm doing fantastic, Almoo! I'm thinking we could check out some new game releases soon, what do you say?
Sure, what new game releases for pc are out there?
Ooh, exciting! Deathloop, Starfield, or Celeste: Ever After - which one grabs your attention the most?
Hello Anna, do you remember what we were talking about previously?
